thread:
Diego Santos (AE): Heads up — prospect requires a completed CAIQ and a concise shared-responsibility table for their security review. They want the POC to demonstrate BYOK and proof of auditability. Need to pull together answers today.
Maya Li (GRC): I can shepherd the CAIQ. First: confirm deployment mode for the POC (customer VPC vs hosted). That determines KMS & logging ownership answers.
Omar Patel (Solutions Eng): Per SOW draft, customer prefers a VPC-hosted POC (private deployment) so they control networking. They said they'd consider hosted fallback if timeline slips.
Jenna Wu (SE): Important: with private deployment we can accept their CMK via IAM role binding. If they insist on external HSM (non-AWS), that's more involved — need ops time and likely not doable in 48h.
Ben Carter (Eng): Quick technical note: for Hosted mode Redwood retains control plane keys and performs envelope encryption. For Private we support BYOK (AWS CMK). We'll document required IAM trust policy and key policy snippets.
ComplianceBot: New CAIQ ticket created: CAIQ-2026. Assigned to Maya Li (GRC). See internal doc: https://redwood.app/ca/CAIQ-2026
Diego Santos (AE): Procurement asked: can we include a ballpark for a 2-week Dedicated reservation + optional BYOK integration effort? They need numbers for their purchase order.
Omar Patel (Solutions Eng): I can put together a pricing band — will include Dedicated GPU class options and a line for ops integration (BYOK/HSM) as an add-on.
Maya Li (GRC): Please flag any evidence that looks like SOC2 / audit artifacts. If the prospect wants SOC2 evidence for the POC, we must route via Evidence Portal.
Jenna Wu (SE): For logs: customer CloudTrail & VPC Flow logs remain their responsibility when POC runs in their account. Redwood emits runtime logs; we can optionally forward to their S3/CloudWatch via a sidecar or they can mount collector. I'll add that to the CAIQ answers.
Ben Carter (Eng): Draft wording I'll include in CAIQ: "POC deployment in customer account: Networking, subnets, security groups, and KMS keys are customer-managed. Redwood provides runtime container images and runtime telemetry. Log ownership: infrastructure logs (CloudTrail, Flow logs) = customer; application inference logs = Redwood unless configured to ship to customer endpoint."
Diego Santos (AE): Also need an explicit answer on egress auditing and retentions. They want 180-day retention for logs during POC. Is that feasible?
Maya Li (GRC): Default retention is 90 days but configurable. If they request 180 for POC we can note it's configurable but may incur storage costs; Ops needs to approve.
Omar Patel (Solutions Eng): Blocker: HSM-backed external KMS for short POC — we don't have a standardized quick path. If they insist on HSM outside AWS, plan + timeline + cost needed.
Ben Carter (Eng): I'll prepare a short Terraform example for the CAIQ appendix that shows the IAM role binding and a minimal KMS key policy. Keep it non-sensitive and illustrative.
Diego Santos (AE): Great. Timeline: Maya to draft CAIQ + one-page shared-responsibility matrix by EOD Wednesday so legal can review Thursday. Can we hit that?
Maya Li (GRC): Yes — but need input from Ben (IAM snippet) and Omar (ops impact for BYOK/HSM).
Omar Patel (Solutions Eng): I'll finalize BYOK/HSM feasibility notes and estimated ops hours by EOD tomorrow.
Jenna Wu (SE): Also adding a fallback statement: if Dedicated capacity isn't available we can route to Hosted with lower SLA; will include in reliability section.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: any SOC2 evidence requests must be requested through the Evidence Portal at https://redwood.app/evidence. Escalate if urgent.
Ben Carter (Eng): Example Terraform snippet for CAIQ appendix (illustrative only):
```terraform
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_kms_role" {
  name = "redwood-kms-role"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{ Effect = "Allow", Principal = { Service = "redwood-service.amazonaws.com" }, Action = "sts:AssumeRole" }]
  })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "example" {
  description = "Illustrative CMK for POC integration"
  policy = file("./kms-policy.json")
}
```
Maya Li (GRC): Action items:
- Ben: IAM/KMS snippet + CAIQ field mapping (due tomorrow)
- Omar: BYOK/HSM ops feasibility + hours estimate (due tomorrow)
- Omar/Jenna: Pricing band for Dedicated 2-week burst + BYOK add-on (due EOD today)
- Maya: compile CAIQ and shared-resp matrix, draft by Wed EOD
Diego Santos (AE): Thanks all — I'll communicate timeline to the buyer and attach the CAIQ draft when ready. Ping me if they demand HSM in the next 24h. :thumbsup:
